subject: Offer proposal: SDE II (backend) — comp breakdown and approval request
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Offer proposal: SDE II (backend) — comp breakdown and approval request

Hi Laura / Marcus,

We've reached the final loop with Priya Shah for the SDE II backend role on my team (HR-REQ-4587). She's enthusiastic and would be a strong pick for the core services team — 6 years experience, solid system design loop, previously led a small infra performance project at ScaleSpark.

Attached is the recommended comp package (SDE2-offer-proposal-20261012.xlsx) and a draft offer letter (offer_letter_v2.pdf). Summary below: 
- Base: $165,000
- Target bonus: 12% (annual)
- Equity: 0.12% (4-year vesting, 1-year cliff)
- Sign-on: $15,000 (prorated over first 6 months to offset counteroffer risk)

Notes / rationale:
- Base sits at midpoint+ of our SDE2 band given Priya's backend specialization and perf tuning work.
- Equity slightly above midpoint to help retention; sign-on is time-limited and tied to start date.
- This role is hiring against an approved headcount for Q4 — headcount ticket in related_links.

Requesting formal approval on base + equity (Marcus) and comp packaging/offer language (Laura). If we can sign off today, I'll ask Talent to extend an offer by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Diego

--
Diego Fernandez
Engineering Manager, Core Services
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer proposal: SDE II (backend) — comp breakdown and approval request

Diego — thanks for the detailed packet and the quick turnaround. A few points from comp & benefits: 

1) Base/bonus: $165k base with 12% target bonus maps to our SDE2 band but is edging toward the top quartile. Please confirm that the market comps you used include Bay Area remote candidates — if Priya will be remote in Austin, we should consider location-adjusted base (our policy: +/- location bands).

2) Equity: 0.12% is reasonable but confirm that total grant value (post-valuation) sits inside the L4/L5 thresholds — I need the numeric grant value at the current strike to finalize.

3) Sign-on: $15k is fine as a one-time payment; recommend making it contingent on a 6-month retention clause (50% repayable if she leaves before 6 months).

If you can send me the salary benchmarking snippet and the equity dollar estimate, I can sign off. Otherwise I can provisionally approve the structure pending the few items above.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer proposal: SDE II (backend) — comp breakdown and approval request

Diego / Laura — quick questions from the budget / banding perspective: 

- Is this role being hired as an L4 or L5? Diego's note said 'SDE II' which historically maps to L4, but the comp is at the higher end of L4. If we intend to pay at this level, we should confirm band elevation or document the business case (critical hire / skills gap / market scarcity).

- Headcount: I want confirmation the req is active in the Q4 forecast and that we have the spend coverage (FY26 hiring bucket). Monica, can you confirm?

I support the package with the retention clause for the sign-on, and Laura's request for equity dollar conversion is reasonable. If Diego shares the benchmarking and Monica confirms headcount, I'm okay to approve.

Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
VP Engineering, Core Platforms
Redwood Inference
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Offer proposal: SDE II (backend) — comp breakdown and approval request

Thanks both — answers inline and attachments updated. See attached spreadsheet (SDE2-offer-proposal-20261012.xlsx) tab 'benchmarks' for the comps I used (mix of Austin and Remote Bay comps):

- Role banding: This is an L4 (SDE II) hire. I pushed base slightly to secure Priya given competing offer from QuickScale (higher base + two interviews). The business case: Priya already knows our stack patterns from previous role and can shorten shipping time on the client batching project; estimated 2 months faster to MVP which offsets comp delta.

- Equity dollar value: I calculated the grant at the current strike price — 0.12% ~= $42,000 present value (using our last 409A). See 'equity_calc' tab.

- Sign-on: agree to retention clause (50% repayable if <6mo).

Monica — can you confirm headcount coverage? If yes, Marcus, can you greenlight the package? Laura, if you want, I can drop base by $5k and add an equivalent to equity to keep cash runway lower; open to feedback.

Diego

--
Diego Fernandez
Engineering Manager, Core Services
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Offer proposal: SDE II (backend) — comp breakdown and approval request

Confirming headcount and budget: this req is in Q4 active hiring list (HR-REQ-4587) and we have FY26 bucket to cover the proposed package including sign-on. No headcount reallocation needed.

Marcus — from a spend perspective, we can absorb the $165k base + bonus + equity and the one-time sign-on. Approving headcount and budget now so Talent can proceed.

Laura — please issue final sign-off on comp structure and offer language; Diego will coordinate extension to the candidate via Anna at Talent Partners.

Thanks,
Monica

--
Monica Patel
Talent Partner, Engineering Hiring Operations
Redwood Inference
